model._comment: Shared last-resort fallback before session model — MiMo cheapest tier, direct xiaomi API.

observerModel._comment: Observer (most frequent): reads new conversation, extracts timestamped facts. MiMo V2.5 = $0.14/$0.28 per MTok, 1M ctx.

observerFallbackModels._comment: Cross-vendor fallback 1: deepseek direct (same price tier, different gateway than xiaomi).
Cross-vendor fallback 2: session model's provider route (commandcode deepseek flash) — same model family via commandcode gateway. Last cheap option before session fallback.

reflectorModel._comment: Reflector (low frequency): distills observations into durable reflections. Needs decent reasoning — MiMo V2.5 fine.

dropperModel._comment: Dropper (low frequency): prunes low-value observations. MiMo V2.5.

_notes: All three memory workers: xiaomi/mimo-v2.5 primary (cheap $0.14/$0.28, 1M ctx, direct xiaomi key).
Fallbacks cross-vendor: deepseek direct → commandcode deepseek — avoid single-gateway outage.
zai-coding-cn/glm NOT used as free worker — package plan expired, now billable.
sessionFallback true: session model is always the absolute last resort.
